issues.description: The problem specification and UML require Farm.animals to be a List<Animal> (specifically initialized as an ArrayList in the no-arg constructor) and the Farm getter/setter to use that List type. The provided solution, however, declares animals as a Set<Animal> (HashSet) and uses Set in the getter/setter. This mismatches the collection type across artifacts and will confuse students about the expected type and initialization (ArrayList vs HashSet).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the collection type consistent with the problem statement. Either (A) update the solution to use List<Animal> and initialize it as new ArrayList<>() in the no-arg constructor and change the getter/setter signatures to use List<Animal>, or (B) if a Set is preferred, update the problem statement and UML to specify Set<Animal> and remove the ArrayList requirement. Preferred: change the solution to use List/ArrayList to match the exercise instructions.
